scope: Authenticated immutable wallet asset delivery and browser HTTP cache; four source/test paths only.
reviewed: Server accepts exactly one lowercase64hex sha256 query for wallet/CRS assets, compares actual decoded bytes before cacheable success, rejects malformed/extra/duplicate queries and pinned runtime.json. Mutable metadata and unpinned routes remain no-store.
Private browser max-age immutable response does not authorize shared CDN caching; gzip/identity Vary, decoded hash, SRI and isolation/CSP headers retained.
Browser uses source descriptors for exact hashed URLs, SRI scripts and bounded/digest-verified JSON; sequential script order and permanent failed-load no-replay fence remain.

Both browser asset60s deadlines and server60s truncation removed. Native finish/close/error owns server response byte release; compressor concurrency32waiters, asset128MiB, cache32MiB and aggregate response128MiB bounds unchanged.
Page exit aborts pending fetch/script load and removes listeners; metadata/API transport bound remains. No custom cache, retry framework, chain or proof changes.

checks.actualBrowserObservation: Headless Chromium fetched immutable artifact once across two documents and mutable metadata twice.

limits: Native browser cache check uses small public fixture; not an actual hosted SDK download benchmark.
